page.metaDescription: Quick help for setup, scans, product access, and results in BCSentinel.
page.title: Find the right answer to common BCSentinel questions.
page.lead: Short checks help with setup, scans, access, and result display. Each topic leads to documentation or support when deeper guidance is needed.

heroAside.title: New to BCSentinel?
heroAside.text: Open setup, register the tenant, test the connection, and start the free scan.

heroAside.title: No access to details?
heroAside.text: Refresh product status and the access snapshot, then check the active access window.

heroAside.title: Technical incident?
heroAside.text: Record the run ID, timestamp, and exact error message before contacting support.

sections.title: Reach the first result in a few steps.
sections.lead: The free scan is the entry point into the BCSentinel customer journey.

cards.title: Open setup
cards.text: Open BCSentinel Setup in Business Central and verify the intended API configuration.

cards.title: Register the tenant
cards.text: Register tenant, environment, and company and complete the required confirmations.

cards.title: Test the connection
cards.text: The connection test should pass before a scan can be started reliably.

cards.title: Start the free scan
cards.text: Trigger the scan, follow the run status to completion, and then open the Free Preview.

sections.title: Why some content is locked or time-limited.
sections.lead: The four product states intentionally grant different scan and access rights.

cards.title: Free Preview
cards.text: Shows a limited overview from the first free scan.

cards.title: Assessment
cards.text: Opens the existing analysis in full for seven days but does not include another scan.

cards.title: Validation
cards.text: Enables a new deep scan after remediation and opens the refreshed result for another seven days.

cards.title: Monitoring
cards.text: Provides full access, scheduled scans, history, trends, and exceptions during the active term.

sections.title: What score, findings, actions, and Estimated Loss mean.
sections.lead: Results support prioritization; they do not automate business decisions.

cards.title: Health Score
cards.text: An overall indication across evaluated data-quality checks. Read it together with severity and module results.

cards.title: Findings
cards.text: Describe the detected issue, severity, and affected records.

cards.title: Actions
cards.text: Recommend a sensible next step while the actual change remains subject to business review and control.

cards.title: Estimated Loss
cards.text: A transparent estimate based on detected records and labelled assumptions, not a guaranteed loss amount.

sections.title: Common issues and the first useful check.
sections.lead: Follow these steps in order before sending a support request.

cards.title: Connection failed
cards.text: Check API URL, HTTPS availability, token configuration, and registered tenant context.

cards.title: Scan does not start
cards.text: Confirm that a scan credit or active Monitoring exists and that no run is already active.

cards.title: Scan remains active
cards.text: Review run ID, heartbeat, and the error message in scan history.

cards.title: No results visible
cards.text: Wait for run completion, then refresh product status and result access.

cards.title: Details are locked
cards.text: Check the active mode and access window. Assessment and Validation are time-limited.

cards.title: Report link does not work
cards.text: Check expiry and access status, then create a new permitted share when required.

sections.title: When to use documentation, support, or contact.
sections.lead: Choosing the right channel reduces follow-up questions and speeds up handling.

cards.title: Documentation
cards.text: For setup, product rights, result interpretation, and systematic troubleshooting.

cards.title: Support
cards.text: For concrete technical incidents, run issues, access errors, or guided pilot onboarding.

cards.title: Contact
cards.text: For demos, pricing, partnership, or general product questions.
